title: The Royal Ball
intro: [excited] Hear ye, hear ye! Welcome in to a royal edition of Disney Jeopardy. Tonight we have princes, princesses, castles and crowns, so put on your finest ballgown... [chuckles] and try not to lose a slipper on the way out.

art.prompt: A sparkling palace ballroom at midnight: crystal chandeliers, a sweeping marble staircase, a single glass slipper on the steps, golden light and drifting confetti. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Tale as Old as Time
categories.intro: [mischievously] Our first category takes us to a certain enchanted castle in France. It is Beauty and the Beast. Be our guest, put your knowledge to the test.

art.prompt: An enchanted rose glowing under a glass bell jar on a table in a candlelit castle library, petals drifting, snow falling outside tall windows. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: The Beast must learn to love before the last petal falls from this enchanted flower.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is a rose. No pressure, Beast, just find true love before your houseplant dies.

clues.clue: This motherly teapot sings the film's title song as Belle and the Beast dance in the ballroom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mrs. Potts, voiced by Angela Lansbury, who nailed the song in a single take. [laughs] Tale as old as time indeed.

clues.clue: Belle's father, a quirky inventor, gets locked in the castle dungeon.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Maurice. He asked for directions in the woods, which is already more than most dads do.

clues.clue: This is the name of Belle's loyal horse, who carries her through the woods to find her father.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Philippe. [chuckles] He outran wolves twice. Somebody get that horse a carrot and a pay raise.

clues.clue: Beauty and the Beast was the first animated feature nominated for this top Academy Award.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Best Picture, for 1991. The Best Animated Feature award did not even exist until 2001.

categories.title: Crowning Achievements
categories.intro: Now a category all about royal kingdoms, titles and family trees. It is called Crowning Achievements. [chuckles] Heavy is the head, folks.

art.prompt: A row of jeweled crowns and tiaras on velvet cushions in a treasure room, beams of sunlight, banners in royal blue and gold. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Elsa is crowned queen of this snowy kingdom in Frozen.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Arendelle. A lovely place to visit, unless your sister has a bad day. Then pack a sweater.

clues.clue: Princess Jasmine's father rules Agrabah with this royal title.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Sultan. [laughs] A man who loves toys and crackers, and trusts Jafar way too much.

clues.clue: Moana is the daughter of the chief of this Polynesian island.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Motunui. Everything you need is on the island, except a very bad chicken named Heihei. Okay, he's there too.

clues.clue: Princess Merida is heir to this Scottish clan in Brave.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is DunBroch. [chuckles] The other three clans are MacGuffin, Dingwall and Macintosh, all competing for Merida's hand. She shot that down.

clues.clue: Prince Naveen of The Princess and the Frog comes from this fictional kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maldonia. His parents cut him off, so he ended up a frog in a New Orleans bayou. Rough gap year.

categories.title: Royal Emoji
categories.intro: Time for some royal hieroglyphics! I will give you a string of emoji and a hint. Name the royal film.

art.prompt: Playful royal objects floating in a pastel sky: a crown, a castle, a frog wearing a tiny crown made of leaves, a sword in a stone, sparkles, bright cartoon style. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: ❄️👑🏰⛄  Hint: she just could not hold it back anymore.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Frozen. Snowflake, crown, castle, snowman. And now that song is stuck in your head. You're welcome.

clues.clue: 👸🍎😴⛏️  Hint: never take fruit from strangers.
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, Disney's very first feature film from 1937. [laughs] Heigh-ho to whoever got that.

clues.clue: 🐸👑💋🎺  Hint: a kiss in New Orleans goes very wrong.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... The Princess and the Frog. The trumpet belongs to Louis, the alligator who just wants to play jazz.

clues.clue: 🗡️🪨👑🦉  Hint: a scrawny boy named Wart.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Sword in the Stone. [chuckles] Wart pulls the sword and becomes King Arthur. The owl is Archimedes, Merlin's very grumpy friend.

clues.clue: 🦊🏹👑👍  Hint: an outlaw versus a thumb-sucking prince.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Robin Hood, from 1973. Prince John sucks his thumb every time someone mentions his mother. Oo-de-lally.

categories.title: Castle Crashers
categories.intro: [excited] To the parks we go! Every Disney park needs a castle, so this category is called Castle Crashers. No moats were harmed.

art.prompt: A fairytale castle with blue and gold spires glowing at dusk, fireworks bursting overhead, a flowered moat bridge in the foreground. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: The castle at the center of Magic Kingdom is named for this princess.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cinderella. Cinderella Castle has been the heart of Magic Kingdom since 1971.

clues.clue: Disneyland in California has a castle named for this sleepy princess.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty. It opened with the park in 1955, four years before the movie even came out. [laughs] Talk about a sneak peek.

clues.clue: Shanghai Disneyland's castle, the largest Disney castle, has this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... the Enchanted Storybook Castle. It does not belong to just one princess. It celebrates all of them.

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland's castle was reimagined in 2020 to honor many Disney princesses and queens under this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Castle of Magical Dreams. [chuckles] Each tower celebrates a different princess or queen. Fourteen royals in one castle. Crowded!

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's Cinderella Castle stands about this tall, more than double Sleeping Beauty Castle's 77 feet.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 189 feet. Imagineers used forced perspective so the upper bricks and windows are smaller, making it look even taller.

categories.intro: [mischievously] The Club DJ members chose Song Combos, royal edition. I have mashed together two royal Disney song titles. Name both songs.
